purpose: Remove pdf-lib and PDF.js entirely, provide native-backed authoring in the standalone PDFium SDK, reduce merged-save time/peak PSS while retaining incremental saves, cancellation and source integrity.
implementation: The application, SDK, tests and lockfile no longer depend on pdf-lib or pdfjs-dist. Font shaping/subsetting uses pdf-fontkit; image/XML codecs are not PDF parsers.
Native xref views implement fonts, form appearances, PNG/JPEG/SVG authoring and metadata. Text replacement and unknown-stamp fallback rendering borrow the same native owner.
Original encoded streams retain immutable owned input slices. Same-document grafts share readers; cross-document grafts copy selected streams so donor input can be released.
One persistent worker/native PDF per tab. Import temporarily opens a donor in that runtime (peak two documents), then closes it. Cancellation restores the native journal.

findings.interpretation: Merged saves improve by 4.6/10.2/11.4 percent over the immediately preceding PDFium revision. Engineering-corpus processing peak PSS falls 11.4/14.5 percent; the book change of 0.6 percent is small. Standalone incremental performance is retained. All three import/save workflows beat the original PDF.js+pdf-lib implementation in these samples.
findings.remainingRegressions: Book tiles remain about 4.42 times the original PDF.js time; first book/vector zooms remain about 2.14/1.37 times PDF.js. Scan PNG export is 7.9 percent slower than the previous PDFium revision (202 to 218 ms), although 72.9 percent faster than PDF.js. This is not a universal render-performance win.
findings.workload: Metadata-only standalone edits preserving the full UI page structure, controls and annotations; entire donor imports followed by merged export. Separate tests/UI/authoring audits cover edited fields, appearance generation and flattening.

methodology.order: Rotated Latin-square order; fresh Chromium process per sample; same corpus entry compiled against each revision.
methodology.memory: Whole Chromium-process PSS, sampled every 50 ms. Processing peak excludes download consumption; including-download peak and SwapPSS are reported separately. Baseline contains both fixture byte arrays. WASM capacity is reserved arena size, not live memory.
methodology.timing: No builds, tests or export validators during measurement. Existing unrelated host services remained active. min/max and median are included; n=3 is not a statistical significance test.
methodology.limitations: Linux ARM64 Cortex-A76, 8 GiB, headless software rendering. Original-engine drawing runs incurred browser swap, and host swap counters changed in some other runs. These are observed end-to-end results, not isolated CPU rankings or Windows/Tauri WebView guarantees. Physical file writes, UI scrolling and displayed-frame latency are outside the timed harness.

correctness.lint: ESLint, app and www TypeScript checks passed; final modified benchmark scripts passed ESLint.
builds: Tauri frontend production build passed; desktop WebView runtime not exercised

fullContentSyntax.scope: Three sources plus first-round candidate standalone and merged outputs, using qpdf 12.4.2 native Job checks with jbig2dec 0.19. Separate from the 81-file structure/raster audit.
fullContentSyntax.explanation: INDOT itself produces 100 compressed-stream-end warning events. The three candidate outputs containing INDOT produce the same category/count; the other five checks have no warnings. Category/count matching is not proof that warnings refer to identical streams.

negativeControls.reason: Both are rejected for missing nested Text annotations and reply relationships by the new independent reader.

correctness.authoring: Independent qpdf/Poppler checks preserve all 10 historical field values, CJK and variable-font text. Editable and flattened appearances have identical pixels; flattened field count is zero. The old standalone library flattened output was not a valid visual reference.
correctness.ui: Offline PWA: edit Bob, two incremental saves without revision-chain growth, blank page, undo/redo, donor import, save/reopen 8 pages and 3 fields. One active worker, zero after close. No page JS errors or visible broken images; one revoked Blob-image request failed during the sequence.
correctness.cancellation: Eight browser attempts: three full, three merged, one early incremental and one original-prefix construction cancellation. All reject, retain one native owner, preserve page pixels, and allow complete retry. Caller rejection 0.1-3.1 ms; worker ready 1.4-60.6 ms after abort (cooperative, not a hard limit).
